preconditions.description: The length of the happy string must be between 1 and 10 inclusive.
The kth happy string to be returned must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: output == '' if len(generateHappyStrings(n)) < k else output in generateHappyStrings(n)
postconditions.description: The output is the kth happy string of length n in lexicographical order if there are at least k happy strings of length n, otherwise an empty string.
